user.title: Add a dashboard
user.description: Each dashboard gets its own sidebar panel. Pictures, floor plans, lights, heating and energy are set up in the panel afterwards.

data_description.title: Shown in the sidebar, for example Home or Summer house.
data_description.url_path: The dashboard opens at your Home Assistant address followed by /address. Leave empty to use the name.
data_description.layout: A house is shown with a picture from outside and floor plans. An apartment is shown with its floor plan only. This can be changed later in the setup guide.

error.invalid_url_path: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only.
error.url_path_taken: Another panel already uses this address.
error.site_in_yaml: A dashboard with this name is set up in configuration.yaml.

abort.already_configured: A dashboard with this name already exists.

update.name: Update
update.description: Install the latest SmartHomeDash from GitHub. A site.json saved on Home Assistant is kept.

overwrite_site.name: Overwrite site.json
overwrite_site.description: Replace the saved site.json with the one in the repository (the old one is kept as site.json.bak).

options.house: House with a picture from outside
